CustomField.description: Formula: true when Sod_Species_Delivered__c matches Expected_Sod_Species__c snapshot. Expected_Sod_Species__c is stored as text at DQC creation. TEXT() on delivered side for consistent picklist comparison. If false and Sod_Included__c is true, FM intervention required. PKG-DQC-PARENT-01b.
CustomField.formula: IF( Sod_Included__c = TRUE, TEXT(Sod_Species_Delivered__c) = Expected_Sod_Species__c, TRUE )
CustomField.label: Sod Species Match
